import.help: Save your fleet spreadsheet as CSV (in Excel: File → Save As → CSV). One row per truck or trailer. It needs a Unit column and a Type column (truck or trailer). These are read if present: VIN, Year, Make, Model, Plate, State, Owner, Odometer, Engine hours, Notes.

wo.signoff_type_name: Type your full name exactly as it appears on your account ({name}).
wo.cancel_help: Only for a job that shouldn't exist, such as a duplicate.

err.password_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
err.email_taken: That email already has an account.

unit.err.type_required: Say whether it's a power unit or a trailer.

vin.warn.short: VIN is {n} characters, not 17. Fine for a pre-1981 unit; otherwise check the plate.
vin.err.long: VIN is {n} characters; a VIN has 17.
vin.err.chars: VIN has a character a VIN never uses (I, O and Q are never used).
vin.warn.check_digit: VIN check digit doesn't add up. Check it against the plate on the unit.
csv.err.unreadable: The file isn't readable text. Save it as CSV.

csv.err.too_big: The file is over 2 MB. A fleet list should be far smaller; is it the right file?
csv.err.rows_bad: {n} row(s) need fixing. Nothing was saved.
wo.err.need_unit: Choose the unit this job is for.
wo.err.unit_retired: That unit has left the fleet.
wo.err.signed_use_amend: This job is signed off. Use a correction (amendment) instead.
wo.err.bad_move: The job can't move to that status from here.
wo.err.not_open: This job is no longer open.
wo.err.bad_tech: One of those people isn't a tech in this company.
wo.err.changed_meanwhile: Someone else changed this job just now. Reload and try again.
wo.err.cannot_amend: Only the shop manager or the tech who signed can correct a signed job.
wo.err.own_labor_only: You can log only your own hours.
wo.err.own_lines_only: You can void only lines you entered.
wo.err.no_line: That line isn't on this job, or it's already void.
